messages:
jordan: ping — alerting: increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Graph shows spike starting ~02:02 UTC. I'm creating the war room now. @oncall-bot please confirm paging.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty notified: oncall@redwood-pd (Sasha) — incident created (INC-2026-042). War room: https://meet.redwood.internal/rooms/INC-2026-042 

sasha: I'm on it. joining war room. Seeing elevated 503/504s in the api gateway logs, mostly to model redwood-open-7b-q4f.

maria: Noted — customer-facing telemetry shows degradation for ~1.8% of requests in eu-west-1, tail latency also increased. No error reports from dedicated customers yet.

blake: quick check: autoscaler in eu-west-1 is healthy — no obvious OOMs on the node pool. Attaching recent tail of gateway logs:```
[2026-03-15T02:03:12Z] upstream 10.0.5.23:503 service_unavailable
[2026-03-15T02:03:13Z] kvcache miss model:redwood-open-7b-q4f shard:3
[2026-03-15T02:03:14Z] conn reset by peer
```

jordan: thanks — Blake/Dev-runtime, can we try routing a small percent of traffic to the compatible variant redwood-open-7b-ptx in eu-central-1 as a fallback? Also can we enable aggressive prefix caching for the candidates?

sasha: I'll coordinate the routing. Plan: 1) Canary 5% to eu-central-1 model redwood-open-7b-ptx 2) If stable for 5m, raise to 25% 3) Notify statuspage and customers. Executing canary now.

ops-bridge-bot: Bridge created: https://ops.redwood.internal/bridges/INC-2026-042 — join link posted to war room.

maria: Drafting status page update: "We are investigating increased error rates for text generation requests in eu-west-1. Some customers may experience 503/504 errors or increased latency. Engineers are actively mitigating and routing traffic to alternate regions; updates at 15-minute intervals." Anyone want to edit?

cust-success: Suggest adding: "No evidence of data loss; requests are either retried or routed. We will notify customers if there is any impact to committed SLAs."

jordan: +1 to that wording. Also add a short note for enterprise customers — contact success@redwood and include incident id INC-2026-042.

blake: Can confirm canary traffic to eu-central-1 started at 02:07 UTC. Initial failure rate on canary is 0.3% vs 2% in eu-west-1.

sasha: Good. Increasing canary to 20% now. Monitoring tracing spans for downstream errors.

maria: Status page update ready. Copy below: "We are aware of increased error rates affecting text generation in eu-west-1. Mitigation is in progress by routing requests to alternate region(s); this may cause higher latency for some users. No data loss reported. Updates every 15 minutes." Approve?

jordan: Approve. Post it and tag ops and customers.

jordan: Posting update to status.redwood.com — command:```
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.com/api/v1/incidents \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_API' \
  -d '{"incident_id":"INC-2026-042","impact":"partial_outage","body":"Investigating increased error rates for text generation in eu-west-1. Mitigations in progress."}'
```

ops-bridge-bot: Webhook confirmed, status page updated.

cust-success: I'll send a short proactive note to impacted customers via Intercom: template below. Please review: "Hi — we're investigating increased errors for generation in eu-west-1 (INC-2026-042). We're routing traffic to alternate regions to limit impact. No action required from your side. We'll update as we learn more."

maria: Looks good. Add estimated ETA for next update: +15m.

blake: Observability note: memory pressure is rising on a subset of model-serving pods in eu-west-1; kernel logs show repeated SIGBUS on process pid 2345 — possible quantization kernel bug triggered by certain sequence lengths. Collecting core dumps now.

jordan: If SIGBUS confirmed, fallback to different quantized binary (q8a -> q4f) is an option. Dev-runtime, can you stage the alternate binary in eu-west-1 and test with smoke traffic?

sasha: Assigning action items: Owner: Sasha (incident commander). Dev-runtime: Blake (implement fallback binary + validate). Observability: Maria (customer impact & telemetry). Support comms: Cust-success (customer outreach). On-call handoff: Jordan -> Sasha at 02:30 UTC.

jordan: Handing over — I'm going offline for a bit. Sasha you're owner. @here please confirm you can receive pages.

sasha: I confirm oncall and phone reachable. PagerDuty escalation set to high.

blake: Started swapping runtime binary in a canary pod:```
kubectl exec -n runtime svc/model-canary -- /bin/bash -c 'systemctl stop modeld && cp /opt/model/bin/q4f /opt/model/bin/active && systemctl start modeld'
```
Canary smoke tests pass locally. Pushing to 2 more hosts.

maria: Customer impact summary so far (to use in customer template): "~1.8% of requests in eu-west-1 affected; retry succeeded for most requests; estimated customer-visible errors <0.5% of calls overall. No SLA breaches detected yet."

cust-success: Sending Intercom note to impacted customers now. Template updated with 'We will follow up if your integration shows persistent errors.'

ops-bridge-bot: Update: bridge participants: jordan, sasha, blake, maria, cust-success.

sasha: Next update planned 02:22 UTC. If fallback binary stabilizes error rate below 0.5%, we'll start scaling back routing.

jordan: thumbs up. Also add a short internal postmortem template link to war room: https://confluence.redwood.internal/incidents/templates/short-postmortem 

sasha: Copying action items into the war room checklist. Will keep updates coming. 

maria: Logging timeline: 02:02 initial spike, 02:07 canary start, 02:10 binary canary validation, 02:15 status page posted, 02:18 customer outreach.

blake: Binary rollout to remaining canary hosts complete at 02:19. Error rate in eu-west-1 is decreasing to 0.6%.

sasha: Confirming — switching to monitoring mode. Assigning post-incident owner: Blake for bug triage; Maria for customer followups. Closing handoff to oncall until escalation needed.

jordan: Great work everyone. If anyone sees regression ping the war room. I'll check back at handoff. :thumbsup:
